pcs.pc_description: receive instructions on work requirement from superior
plan the target on number of pieces to be completed
ensure to receive the job sheet and hammer from the concerned department
report any defect of the hammer used to the concerned person
collect the metal to be hammered
tape the ends of the metal surface to avoid slipping while hammering
ensure to perform hammering in a bright lightened place
take care of the working height between the body and the metal to be hammered to avoid causing injury and stress during work
ensure to hold the hammer in a straight position with a relaxed yet firm grip to avoid choke up and pain in the hands for holding it for a long time
ensure to put thumb and forefinger straight along the handle
ensure uniform marks and textures are formed by hammering every blow with equal force
refine the surface of the metal surface and smoothen the hammer marks
ensure to wear safety accessories such as eardrums for hammer noise, leather gloves, etc.
ensure a proper finish as per requirement
ensure the target number of pieces are hammered
ensure the output delivered is defect free and hazard free

pcs.pc_description: receive instructions on work requirement from superior.
understand the filing method and read the job sheet to understand design requirement.
plan the target number of pieces to be completed.
select the appropriate tools to file such as hand files, needle files, knife files, etc.
collect and arrange the materials to begin the process.
report on any shortage or defect of raw materials to the concerned person.
ensure to stock the required materials in advance.
collect the metal product to be filed from the concerned department.
ensure the product to be filed is smoother than the file and hardened metal is not used.
inspect the received metal product for any casting defects and send to the concerned department for correction.
report to the supervisor if the defected piece cannot be rectified.
clean the received metal piece.
use appropriate lubricants for the cleaning process.
cut and remove the excess metal from the casted metal surface.
file the edges, grooves and irregular surfaces of the metal according to design specifications.
check and rectify the size and shape of the metal piece matching with the design requirements.
ensure to use the appropriate tools for the filing process.
ensure to take the essential safety measures to perform the process.
ensure accuracy and cleanliness in the filing process as per requirement.
ensure the target number of pieces are filed.
ensure the output delivered is defect free and hazard free.
